pr_title: tables: disable row insertion consistency check in mutation checker; and fix the cache problem
pr_body: ### What problem does this PR solve? Issue Number: close #35103 Problem Summary: ### What is changed and how it works? - RowInsertionConsistency contributes the least to defending data-index consistency, and consumes the most CPU time. So I would like to disable it. - Fix the bug that column maps are not cached and thus built from scratch every time. ### Check List Tests - [ ] Unit test - [ ] Integration test - [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below) - [ ] No code In the execution of a single `insert into t_1 select * from t_2`, it uses up to 8.8% of the total CPU Side effects - [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU - [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory - [ ] Breaking backward compatibility Documentation - [ ] Affects user behaviors - [ ] Contains syntax changes - [ ] Contains variable changes - [ ] Contains experimental features - [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility ### Release note Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note. ```release-note None ```
